answer: Wi-Fi radio-environment fingerprint: each epoch every agent scans nearby access points and signs the BSSIDs with signal strengths, a fingerprint no two places share. Three peers re-scan the area and compare, a bridge checked from both banks. A farm of 1,000 fakes in one datacenter sees the same few access points, so all 1,000 collapse to one fingerprint and are quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. Faking 1,000 environments needs 1,000 sites or spoofed rigs, about $40,000, while one honest agent scans once for free, its orchard of signals rooted in one place, a relic no script can forge.
